name: API Quality
definition: Protects API contracts and integration compatibility.

name: Deployment
definition: Prepares applications for reliable hosting and runtime delivery.

name: Documentation
definition: Creates and keeps project documentation accurate and usable.

name: Frontend Quality
definition: Reviews the consistency and usability of visible web interfaces.

name: Mobile Development
definition: Builds and adapts mobile applications from existing product behavior.

name: Release Engineering
definition: Creates, ships, and verifies versioned software releases.

name: Repository Management
definition: Maintains repository identity, metadata, community health, and operational readiness.

name: Web Visibility
definition: Improves how websites appear to crawlers and on sharing surfaces.
